sources.snippet: What is mscoco_finetuned_CoCa-ViT-L-14-laion2B-s13B-b90k? This model represents a sophisticated vision-language model that combines the Contrastive Captioner (CoCa) architecture with the Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone, specifically fine-tuned on the MSCOCO dataset.
